headline: Aha Moku o Maui Hikina

meeting.summary: BLNR rejected the operator's request for a contested case (a trial-like hearing) after an executive session (a closed-door discussion).
meeting.recap: BLNR rejected the operator's request for a contested case (a trial-like hearing) after an executive session (a closed-door discussion).[[0:09:16]] On September 11, the operator's attorney filed an appeal of that denial in circuit court.[[0:09:48]] A prehearing is set for October 1, with hearings November 4 and 5.[[0:22:30]] Hearings are planned for Oʻahu, not Maui, but that is not yet decided.[[0:23:05]] The attorney said the case is only about the 2026 and 2027 permits, not the long-term license.[[0:35:03]] The next meeting is a public meeting on October 13 at the Kula Community Center.[[0:51:36]] There was nothing new to report on land negotiations for the East Maui irrigation system.[[0:55:03]] The East Maui Water Authority grant program's funding doubled this year to $150,000.[[0:58:04]] Staff are starting a watershed plan based on the ahupuaʻa, a traditional Hawaiian resource management system.[[1:02:26]] Applications are open for three board seats that will open in spring 2027.[[1:12:49]]
meeting.next: The county attorney will update the board after the October 1 prehearing. Hearings are estimated at 15 days, with a result hoped for by the end of the year. The director was asked to look into a short online special meeting for a contested case update after October 1. At the next stakeholders committee meeting, the vice chair will present on the history of DHHL and East Maui water. The director will bring the next year's budget to the board at its October meeting.
